title: Aadhaar-enabled payments hit over 100 million in Oct, led by 99 million cash withdrawals
summary:
While Aadhaar-enabled Payments System witnessed 6.7% increase in transactions to 100.87 million in October compared to 94.50 million seen in September 2026, cash withdrawals rose 7.0% with the transaction value increasing 7.7% in October

llm_summary: In October, the Aadhaar‑enabled Payments System (AEPS) crossed the 100‑million‑transaction mark, posting a 6.7% month‑on‑month rise to 100.87 million transactions.
